what_the_train_exemplars_store_is: SLURP v2 base program module M1 / cell B1 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-slurp-v2-base-program-design.md section 3-4; A2 decision docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-a2-exemplar-headroom-audit-v1.md): the top-20 TRAIN construction-pool exemplars (excluding every utterance with a recording in TRAIN Fold A, Fold B or DEV-1000; 9,354-facet pool) recalled by cosine against this row's OWN sealed TRAIN Fold B speech vector, ranked by saea-rank-wcos-prior-agree-v1 (identity on cosine: w_cos=1, w_prior=0, w_agree=0) and passed through saea-fuse-supplyfilter-v1 with m=c=top_l=20 -- twenty in, twenty out on every row, the same 'no coverage reshaping' discipline cell KU-S3 established. Each value renders as '<utterance> | <scenario>_<action> | type=filler; ...' (KB view annotated-exemplars, scripts/build_knowledge_snapshot.py). The decision is delivered to the SOLVER phase (the program's LAST phase) through the E6 acquire transition -- NOT the bootstrap seam intent-boundaries uses, because solver is not the first phase -- as typed content blocks (evidence_id/source_uri/knowledge_role='value', store-prefixed 'train-exemplars::...'); the Solver's instruction bytes are byte-identical to the unmodified anchor's. The composed acquire transition also carries the slot-contracts store's own candidate_supply.solver decision on the same wave; both compose into one PhaseSupply via rails.knowledge_stores._compose_supplies. Phase-2 re-target (P-SV-1/P-SV-2): only the query file moves (TRAIN Fold A -> TRAIN Fold B, the pin the filler family uses); the store, its release and its snapshot are byte-identical.
